signature.name: Red Rocks Amphitheatre
signature.detail: A dramatic open-air venue set between towering red sandstone rocks, famous for its acoustics and scenery. It is a must-see even without a show; go early morning for a free walk or check the concert calendar and book tickets well in advance.

signature.name: Denver Art Museum
signature.detail: Home to a striking collection of Indigenous and Western American art, plus a renowned architecture and design department. Visit on a weekday morning to avoid crowds; tickets are timed, so book online.

signature.name: Denver Botanic Gardens
signature.detail: A lush 24-acre oasis with themed gardens and a conservatory, perfect for a relaxing stroll. Go in spring or early summer for peak blooms; arrive by 10am for cooler temperatures and fewer visitors.

signature.name: Colorado State Capitol
signature.detail: A gold-domed landmark offering free guided tours and a mile-high marker on its steps. Tours run on weekdays; dress comfortably for the walk up to the dome.

signature.name: Union Station
signature.detail: A beautifully restored Beaux-Arts terminal that now houses shops, restaurants, and a lively bar scene. It is a great starting point for exploring downtown; stop by for a coffee or an evening drink.

signature.name: 16th Street Mall
signature.detail: A mile-long pedestrian promenade lined with shops and cafes, ideal for a casual walk. The free MallRide shuttle runs its length, making it easy to hop on and off.

signature.name: Coors Brewery
signature.detail: Take a free tour of one of the world's largest breweries in nearby Golden and sample fresh beer. Tours fill up quickly, so reserve online; bring ID for the tasting.

signature.name: Elitch Gardens
signature.detail: A downtown amusement park with roller coasters and family rides, open seasonally. Check the website for opening dates and buy tickets online for discounts.

transport: Light rail $3 a ride; day pass $6; taxis moderate
